sources.citation: Tedman et al., Efficient experimental characterization of the GPCRome via deep receptor scanning, Nat Commun 2026 (bioRxiv 2025.09.19.677468, PMC12458215)

sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Cell surface GB2 expression confirmed by anti-Myc immunofluorescence in living (non-permeabilized) cells; GABA_B receptor signaling function assessed in co-expression with GB1. Wild-type Myc-GB2 showed normal surface expression and served as the functional reference.
sites.rationale: The mGluR5 signal peptide drives the Myc-tagged GB2 to the cell surface; after SP cleavage the Myc tag is the first extracellular sequence preceding the mature GB2 N-terminus. In canonical GABBR2 numbering the native SP spans residues 1–41 (last residue G41), so the tag is placed after residue 41 and before the mature N-terminal W42. Python confirmed G at position 41 and W at position 42. The extracellular domain runs 42–478 (437 residues), placing the tag >437 residues from TM1 and well clear of any TM boundary. L2 (PMC7429364) independently corroborates this junction with an HA-HA tag on GABBR2(41–941) used in signaling assays. mGluR5 signal peptide + Myc-tag introduced into full-length human GB2 and disease variants (GB2-S695I, GB2-A567T, GB2-I705N), co-expressed with GB1 in HEK293T cells; surface expression assessed by anti-Myc staining of non-permeabilized (living) cells and total expression after permeabilization using anti-Myc and anti-GB2 antibodies.

sources.claim: The A567T variant in TM3 is situated in a region regulating constitutive receptor activity, whereas the S695I and I705N variants in TM6 are located in a region controlling receptor activation and allosteric modulation. 48 We co-expressed Myc-tagged GB2 variants along with GB1 in HEK293T cells and assessed GB2 cell surface and total expression levels before and after cell permeabilization, respectively, using anti-Myc and anti-GB2 antibodies ( Fig. 1B ).

literature_notes: L1 (PMC11788220) reports a flag-tagged rat GABBR2 in pRK5 but states no residue position for the flag tag; the clip cannot be used to pin insert_after_residue and was not promoted to a site. L6 (PMC13168656) reports a flag-tagged full-length human GB2 in pCDNA3.1 but likewise states no tag position; not promoted. L2 (PMC7429364) corroborates the N-terminal site (HA-HA tag on GABBR2 41–941 used in signaling assays) but L4 provides the stronger surface-expression validation and was chosen as the primary clip. No internal extracellular loop sites are supported by the ledger: no clip reports a tolerated tag insertion in any of the short extracellular loops (ECL1 537–550, ECL2 618–652, ECL3 714–717) of GABBR2.

literature_other_positions.note: A567T variant in TM3 (551–576) disrupts constitutive receptor activity; intramembrane position, not a surface tag site.
G693W (rat G692W equivalent) in TM6 (691–713) disrupts receptor function; intramembrane position, not a surface tag site.
S695I (rat S694I equivalent) in TM6 (691–713) disrupts receptor activation and allosteric modulation; intramembrane position, not a surface tag site.
I705N (rat I704N equivalent) in TM6 (691–713) disrupts receptor activation and allosteric modulation; intramembrane position, not a surface tag site.
